parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of a request. This token is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: ColdStorageInstanceDescription
parameters.description: The description of the cold storage instance. The description can be up to 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query the details of all clusters in your account, such as the cluster ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.
